title: Eternia's Improved Progression
description: adds a variety of new items and recipes that helps smooth out the exponential progression curve in minecraft
body:
# Eternia's Improved Progression
This mod addes a variety of new items and recipes to help smooth out the exponential progress curve of minecraft.

While still in it's early stages it's my mission to ensure that minecraft is a completly
different game when I'm done with it :)

I hope you enjoy and support this mod by playing so I can keep on adding more and more cool features to make minecraft a game that has a longer phase than 2 weeks


Here are some questions I thought I'd Answer just incase
## What kind of changes will this mod make?
So far we only added a new set of armour and tools and some new recipes but in the future I plan to redesign the enchanting system, levels, add new bosses, more end and nether content and much more
## Will this mod conflict with other progression mods?
This is improbable in the early development of the mod although if development continues the risks of this are higher but if you find a conflict feel free to contact me via email: ashy1464032@protonmail.com or on discord: Ashy146 if you have discovered any conflicts.
## How do I report bugs?
Discord is preferred either on my server or via messaging me directly in the future I'm sure I can sort out an official issue/bug tracker at some point
## Will this mod move to other Mod loaders/versions?
Porting to different versions is one matter which will depend on if I get extra free time and the mod becomes popular but No, it stays on neoforge as I'm one dev and not a god 10x developer at that so supporting multiple mod loaders is out of the question.

And finally please enjoy my mod if you do decide to give it a download and play it for yourself and sorry I couldn't think of a better description haha.
